dedupe_keys.name: global wind wave and swell climate 1950 2100

description: The MASNUM-WAM research team publishes global wind-wave and swell simulations for wave-climate and marine-energy studies. ScienceDB describes 17 wave parameters with wind fields, covering a historical experiment from 1950 to 2014 and future scenarios from 2015 to 2100 at three-hour intervals. The current public release lists 73,653 files and about 3.77 TB. NetCDF data are free under CC BY 4.0. The series can supply resource and environmental-loading inputs for marine-energy planning and complement energy assessments using model-system-advisor-model-sam. A caveat is that results depend on the selected FIO-ESM forcing and wave model, not representing measured waves at every location. The repository description names SSP125, whereas the article names SSP126; scenario identifiers should therefore be checked in file metadata before use. The metadata and access page were inspected without downloading climate files.
